'''Silent Bob'''<ref name="dt-14254">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14254 The Day is MINE], DeckTech (Silent "Silent Bob" Bob, 4 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14254/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14254/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018065910/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14254/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Silent Bob''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
